provenance.note: Controller addresses are capture-local provenance; actor/model/motion identity selects frames across allocation changes.

modelBinding.evidence: The live Dreamcast CLMD record stores actor code RYO_ at +0x4c and the compact-controller pointer at +0x2c. The Disc 1 global SCENE/01/MODEL/CHARA archive supplies its canonical RYO_M model.

runtimeCurveAffines.evidence: Native runtime curves apply output = MOT sample * scale + base. Identity-only fixtures isolate MOT decoding and procedural solvers; non-identity captures retain transition/blend state separately.

callbackPhaseCoherence.evidence: A synchronized callback frame must reproduce its captured +0x230 controller-0 intermediate from the three descriptors that the native callback consumed. Natural same-cycle GDB/SH-4 traces stay below 0.024 degrees; larger errors prove that RAM inputs and the renderer matrix came from different scheduler phases. Rejected frames remain listed here and are not used as browser failures.
